data.title: 雅儿贝德 · 大理石案台的白裙更衣自抚
data.description: 总管书房深处冰凉的黑色大理石案几前，雅儿贝德纯白礼服半解拉至胸下，饱满雪乳溢出，雪白丰臀在月色中弓起动人曲线。她一手按在大理石桌面上俯身弓腰，漆黑的巨大羽翼在身后因燥热微微颤抖。单手探入裙底拉开薄透内裤边缘自抚水润花瓣，咬着下唇回眸，金色竖瞳泛着被爱意与快感填满的狂热春水——「啊……哈……身体好热……雅儿贝德的心与身体……全部只属于您一个人……」
data.location: 黑曜石与大理石精工雕刻的长案几旁
data.action: 一手按案几俯身翘臀，白裙半解羽翼微颤，单手探入自抚敏感花瓣，回眸含情喘息
data.lighting: 透过彩色穹顶照在大理石上的幽冷月色
data.promptProse: In the quiet study beneath a glazed dome, Albedo bends over a cold black marble table with one palm flat against the polished stone and her dark wings trembling behind her. Cool moonlight falls across the desk and outlines her figure as she glances back over her shoulder.
data.nsfwProse: Her white evening gown with its gold web necklace is loosened down to her waist to bare her chest, while the hem is gathered high so her free hand can slide past the edge of her sheer panties to touch herself.
data.animaCaption: Leaning forward over the dark marble table with her white gown lowered past her chest and skirt gathered at her hips, she braces one hand on the stone while her other hand slips beneath her shifted panties as she looks back with a flushed, lip-biting gaze.
